steps.name: apply-climate-io-adapter-doc-sync-from-clean-head
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=c7da0e33a82680558b2f27d85652d7d8e43d72c3
git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller agent-control
git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage24/apply_stage24a_climate_io_adapter.py > /tmp/apply-stage24a-climate-io-adapter.py
git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage24/sync_stage24a_docs.py > /tmp/sync-stage24a-docs.py
.venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage24a-climate-io-adapter.py
.venv/bin/python /tmp/sync-stage24a-docs.py
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for path in [Path('README.md'), Path('AGENTS.md'), *Path('docs').glob('*.md')]:
    text = path.read_text()
    path.write_text('\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()) + ('\n' if text.endswith('\n') else ''))
PY
.venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.h src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.cpp test/test_climate_io_adapters/test_main.cpp || true
.venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.h src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.cpp test/test_climate_io_adapters/test_main.cpp
git diff --check
git status --short

steps.name: focused-climate-io-adapter-contract
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests
cmake --build build/host-tests --target climate_io_adapter_tests --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R '^climate_io_adapter_tests$' --output-on-failure
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.h src/climate/ClimateIoAdapters.cpp test/test_climate_io_adapters/test_main.cpp README.md docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/CHANGELOG.md docs/PROJECT_LAYOUT.md docs/MVP_HARDWARE_SENSOR_SET.md docs/INTEGRATION_CONVERGENCE.md docs/PORTING_TO_LITEGRAPH.md AGENTS.md
grep -F 'ClimateInputAdapter' docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
grep -F 'ClimateActuatorAdapter' docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
grep -F 'ESP-IDF 5.5.4' README.md
git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-repair-idf-v5-5-4-and-publish-stage24a
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
git add -A
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'
bash scripts/check_schema.sh
cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests
cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel
ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure
bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh
unset VIRTUAL_ENV CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONHOME || true
export PATH='/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin'
if [ ! -x "$HOME/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.14_env/bin/python" ]; then
  env -u VIRTUAL_ENV -u CONDA_PREFIX -u PYTHONHOME PATH='/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin' bash "$HOME/esp/esp-idf/install.sh" esp32s3
fi
source "$HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh"
idf.py --version | grep -F 'ESP-IDF v5.5.4'
test "$(git -C "$HOME/esp/esp-idf" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)" = 'v5.5.4'
rm -rf build/idf-gate
bash scripts/idf_gate_build.sh
git diff --check
git add -A
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m 'Add climate I/O adapter seam and refresh docs'
git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
printf 'PUBLISHED_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
